refnamediv.refpurpose: Estimate (mean square) coherence of signals x and y. Use the Welch (1967) periodogram/FFT method.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [Pxx, freq] = mscohere (x, y) […] = mscohere (x, y, window) […] = mscohere (x, y, window, overlap) […] = mscohere (x, y, window, overlap, Nfft) […] = mscohere (x, y, window, overlap, Nfft, Fs) […] = mscohere (x, y, window, overlap, Nfft, Fs, range) mscohere (…)

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: See "help pwelch" for description of arguments, hints and references
